parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the job template.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number. The value starts from 1.

parameters.name: FieldType
parameters.description:
The dimension by which to filter job templates. Valid values:

- **appName**: The name of the job template.

- **appIds**: The ID of the job template.

parameters.name: FieldValue
parameters.description: The name or ID of the target job template. This value corresponds to the dimension specified by **FieldType**.

parameters.name: OrderBy
parameters.description:
The sorting method for the job templates. Valid values:

- **running**: Sorts by the number of running instances.

- **instances**: Sorts by the number of destination instances.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 0 to 200.

parameters.name: Reverse
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to sort the results in ascending or descending order based on the field specified by the **OrderBy** parameter. Valid values:

- **true**: ascending order.

- **false**: descending order.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description:
A list of tags. This is a JSON string. The value consists of the following parts:

- **key**: The tag key.

- **value**: The tag value.

parameters.name: Workload
parameters.description: The workload. Set the value to `job`.
